requests.text: Short abstract near-miss cooldown: a soft sideways ribbon-air flutter and muted wood chime settling down. Give the chime a clean rounded upper-mid attack and healthy level, audible beneath music at quiet MacBook playback, never sharp or loud. Entirely acoustic and nonverbal. No breath, gasp, human or animal vocalization, voice, speech, singing, melody, whisper-quiet output, harsh transient, alarm, aggressive impact, simulation, or arcade sound.
